rules.statement: A planting agreement that provides a planter with the right to deliver a share of produce and possess the remaining portion as compensation creates a permanent right of property in the trees on the land, which can be sold under section 14 of the Partition Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "In view of the terms of this paragraph, the trial Judge holds that the respondent is in a more secure position than a person having a permanent right to growing trees on the land sought to be partitioned. This is so, he states, because under the agreement P 10 not only his rights but those of his heirs and successors are secured."
